Payment of engage persons will be made to the service provider on monthly basis. xvi) All necessary reports and other information shall be supplied immediately as required and regular meeting will be held with the Buyer. xvii) Service Provider will provide the details of wages in bifurcated manners i.e. basic rates, EPF, ESI, Service Tax and any other tax etc.

26) Conflict of Interest among Bidders/Agents A bidder shall not have conflict of interest with other bidders. Such conflict of intere st can lead to anti-competitive practices to the detriment of Procuring Entity’s inter ests. The bidder found to have a conflict of interest shall be disqualified. A bidder m ay be considered to have a conflict of interest with one or more parties in this biddi ng process, if: a) They have controlling partner (s) in common; or b) They receive or have received any direct or indirect subsidy/ financial stake fro m any of them; or c) They have the same legal representative/agent for purposes of this bid; or d) They have relationship with each other, directly or through common third partie s, that puts them in a position to have access to information about or influence on the bid of another Bidder; or e) Bidder participates in more than one bid in this bidding process. Participation b y a Bidder in more than one Bid will result in the disqualification of all bids in which the parties are involved. However, this does not limit the inclusion of the components/ sub-assembly/ Assemblies from one bidding manufacturer in more than one bid. COMMON IP ADDRESSES: Bidders are advised that the GeM portal records and di 27) splays the IP addresses used by both Buyers and Bidders/Sellers during the bidding process. Bidders are therefore advised to ensure that bids are submitted from secu re and independent networks to maintain transparency and avoid rejection on acco unt of common IP usage. However, submission of multiple bids from the same IP address sh all be permissible if the bids pertain to different items.
